pages.title: Nylium Blocks
pages.text: Blocks identical to vanilla Nylium blocks with an additional state $(l:basics/fertile_state)FERTILE$(). They can spread. The function can be changed in the configuration file.

pages.title: Nylium Slabs
pages.text: They have the same capabilities as a full block. By default you cannot plant plants on their lower half, but you can change this in the config.
